name: Clock Face Picker
description: Pick a time by dragging the hands of an analogue clock, with the time shown digitally above and an AM/PM switch for 12-hour use.

props.name: value
props.description: The time (controlled), a Time from @internationalized/date. Seconds are ignored.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called as a hand moves to a new hour or minute, from a drag, a key press or the AM/PM switch.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between the minute hand's stops.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: 12 shows the AM/PM switch; 24 writes hours 00 to 23. Defaults to the locale's preference.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Dims the picker and ignores input.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Other div props are passed through.
